title: 第二十一章 实力暴涨第五章 奖励 特殊天赋
content_zh:
即使内外勾结，也很难将一个门派给灭了。
“下毒。”宋远桥想到了关键处，“在饭菜中下毒。要是这样，叶恒绝不是孤身一人，而是背后站着一方势力，元庭？”
饭桌上的几人无不呼吸一滞。
要是元庭。
江湖危矣。
相较而言，江湖太小，朝廷太大。
任你实力再强，面对大军围困，也只有坐以待毙的份儿。
这完全是两个层面。
“不会！”林凡却摇头，“要是元庭出手，就不会这么小家子气，叶恒身边至少会跟着不少高手配合。或者，元庭直接培养一批会吞噬功法的高手，那么整个江湖，会飞快地土崩瓦解。”
众人心中一寒。
“培养一批吞噬真气的高手？”宋远桥的声音都轻了，有些飘忽，微微发颤。
老张却摇头：“有了这等功法，谁愿意传出去？哪怕皇室得到，也不会乱传的。毕竟，侠以武犯禁，皇室也会害怕反噬。”
他看向了宋远桥：“最近几个月，可有人上山？”
“除了小师弟外，没有其他人。”宋远桥想了想道，“两个月前，山下有不少人拜师，都被挡在了外面。最近两个月，反而清净了，十分怪异。”
“不用多想。”老张摆摆手，“吃饭，快吃饭，都凉了。”
众人这才纷纷拿起筷子。
晚饭后。
林凡跟着老张来到了后山。
“师尊，您老真不担心？”
“那个叶恒？没什么好担心的！吞噬真气，而且是大量吞噬，必然会导致真气驳杂不纯，前期或许能突飞猛进，等到了后期，想要更进一步，却会难之又难。甚至真气冲突，走火入魔。”

“还是您老眼光毒辣。”
“也不看看老道是谁。小凡子，继续修炼。”
“好！”
林凡修炼太极真功之余，也进一步参悟降龙十八掌，摧心掌，梯云纵，武当长拳，绵掌，绕指柔剑法，九宫连环剑等等。
他的进境一日千里。
这让老张都不停赞叹。
用他的话说，要是两人出生在同一个时代，哪还有他什么事儿。
聊天群中。
战力榜的排名，林凡的名字也接连提升。
终于引起了注意。
纪小川：【林兄提升好快，从原先的三十多名，直接来到了第十名。】
纪小川：【我鈤，一日之内，直接晋升到了第六名。】
纪小川：【林兄这是拜入武当谁的名下了？修炼了什么功法，怎么提升这么快？】
张大年：【我听说了，林凡兄弟拜在了张真人名下，成了张真人的关门弟子。】
纪小川：【张真人？是那位武林泰斗老神仙？号称当今武林第一人，将近百岁的张真人？】
张大年：【是的！几个月前我就在少林听说了，当时羡慕的差点质壁分离。好歹我有功夫在身，也假借是少林俗家弟子的名头，结果上山后，我剃了光头，却只成了烧火的头陀，兼顾洒扫】
张大年：【我气的差点七窍冒烟】
张大年：【你们知道我听说林兄拜入张真人门下的感觉吗？两眼泪汪汪的。我都是二次降临了，林兄才是第一次，怎么就被老神仙看中了？不可思议，无法理解】
郭婷婷：【林兄确实拜入了张真人座下，我们峨眉第一时间就得到了消息，毕竟我们两个门派关系非常好】
郭婷婷：【我向师父打听了，她也不知道林兄是如何拜在张真人名下的，不理解，但很厉害】
content_en:
Even if internal and external collusion occurs, it is difficult to destroy a sect.
"Poison." Song Yuanqiao thought of the key point, "Poison in the food. If so, Ye Heng is definitely not alone, but there is a force standing behind him, Yuan Ting?"
Everyone at the dinner table was breathing heavily.
If it were Yuanting.
The world is in danger.
In comparison, the Jianghu is too small and the imperial court is too big.
No matter how strong you are, facing the siege of a large army, you can only sit back and wait for death.
This is completely two levels.
"No!" Lin Fan shook his head, "If Yuanting takes action, he won't be so petty. Ye Heng will at least have many masters around him to cooperate. Or if Yuanting directly cultivates a group of masters who can devour the skills, then the entire world will fall apart very quickly."
Everyone felt a chill in their hearts.
"Cultivate a group of masters who can swallow Qi?" Song Yuanqiao's voice became softer, a little erratic and trembling slightly.
But Lao Zhang shook his head: "With such a skill, who would want to spread it? Even if the royal family gets it, they will not spread it randomly. After all, if a hero breaks the law with force, the royal family will be afraid of backlash."
He looked at Song Yuanqiao: "Has anyone been going up the mountain in the past few months?"
"Except for my junior brother, there is no one else." Song Yuanqiao thought for a while and said, "Two months ago, there were many people at the foot of the mountain who were apprentices, but they were all blocked out. In the past two months, they have become quieter, which is very strange."
"Don't think too much." Lao Zhang waved his hand, "Eat, eat quickly, it's already cold."
Only then did everyone pick up their chopsticks.
After dinner.
Lin Fan followed Lao Zhang to the back mountain.
"Master, are you really not worried?"
"That Ye Heng? There is nothing to worry about! Swallowing the true energy, and swallowing it in large quantities, will inevitably lead to the pure and impure true energy. In the early stage, you may be able to make rapid progress, but in the later stage, it will be very difficult to go further. You may even conflict with the true energy and go crazy."
"You still have a vicious eye."
"Don't even look at who the old Taoist is. Xiao Fanzi, continue to practice."
"Okay!"
In addition to practicing Tai Chi, Lin Fan also further understood the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, Heart-Destroying Palm, Tiyunzong, Wudang Changquan, Cotton Palm, Finger Wrap Soft Sword Technique, Nine Palaces Chain Sword, etc.
His progress was rapid.
This made Lao Zhang keep praising him.
In his words, if the two of them were born in the same era, there would be nothing wrong with him.
In the chat group.
Lin Fan's name also improved one after another in the ranking of the combat power list.
Finally got attention.
Ji Xiaochuan: [Brother Lin has improved so quickly, from the original ranking of more than 30 to the tenth. 】
Ji Xiaochuan: [I, in one day, I was directly promoted to sixth place. 】
Ji Xiaochuan: [Whose name is Brother Lin in Wudang? What skills did you practice and how did you improve so quickly? 】
Zhang Danian: [I heard that brother Lin Fan worshiped Master Zhang and became his disciple. 】
Ji Xiaochuan: [Zhenren Zhang? Is it that old martial arts master? The nearly 100-year-old Zhang Zhenren, who is known as the number one person in martial arts today? 】
Zhang Danian: [Yes! I heard about it in Shaolin a few months ago, and I was so envious that I almost fell apart. At any rate, I had some skills, and I pretended to be a lay disciple of Shaolin. As a result, after I went up the mountain, I shaved my head, but I only became a fire-burning tutu, doing the cleaning at the same time.]
Zhang Danian: [I was so angry that there was almost smoke coming out of my mouth]
Zhang Danian: [Do you know how I felt when I heard that Brother Lin became a disciple of Zhenren Zhang? Both had tears in their eyes. I am here for the second time, but Brother Lin is here for the first time. Why did he get noticed by the old god? Incredible, incomprehensible]
Guo Tingting: [Brother Lin has indeed become the servant of Master Zhang. We in Emei got the news immediately. After all, our two sects have a very good relationship]
Guo Tingting: [I asked Master about it, and she didn’t know how Brother Lin came to be named under Master Zhang. I don’t understand it, but it’s very powerful]
